prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 74-year-old grandfather in an olive cardigan sits near a New Year tree in an ordinary living room, carefully opening a plain kraft-paper gift with a delighted curious smile. His hands hold the paper naturally and remain clear. Use a candid medium portrait, warm lamp light, and glowing decorations without labels or lettering. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: the fictional grandfather has thin white hair, a gently receding hairline, large black rectangular glasses, a clean-shaven face and a slender body. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 4:5, vertical.
review: Vertical portrait shows an elderly white-haired man in glasses opening kraft paper beside the tree. Distinct realistic wrinkles, both hands and gift-opening gesture are coherent. Head and important fingers are safely framed.
